title: Grocery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established supermarket, delivery and meal patterns when you are modelling everyday food spend and budget habits. Confirm coverage, hours and offers on each site — this block is not a ranking of cheapest chains.

items.reason: Full-service benchmark with Bonus offers and private-label ranges — useful when modelling savings inside a convenient weekly store.
App-based grocery delivery — compare total cost including fees with a list-led in-store shop when time-poor weeks tempt convenience spend.
Meal kits for predictable dinner costs — compare per-serving price with store-brand cooking and leftover habits before treating it as a supermarket replacement.
